what_this_is: Every invitation to a pursuit, as DATA for src/space-invitation.mjs: the invite link's own page (its address is src/space-settings.json invites.join_address) in each state it can be in, the welcome after joining, the email, the text message and the link-preview card. Words fill {inviter}, {invitee}, {space}, {people}, {date} and {link} from the pursuit, the person who made the invite and the person it is for; a word that has nothing to fill it uses its `_unnamed` twin. `people` says who is in the pursuit by how many names are known and how many more there are (`one`, `one_and_one`, `one_and_more`, `two`, `two_and_one`, `two_and_more`, `three`), with {first}, {second}, {third} and {rest}. The email is sent and drawn by the one sender (src/mail-sender.mjs, src/mail-settings.json), from its address and in its colours. `card_roles` names, for each colour role and face the link-preview card reads, the workspace look's variable it comes from (src/page-look.mjs). `text_senders` are the ways a text can go out through the inviter's own connected accounts: each runs its `tool_id` with { to, text } (the tool another builder owns); a sender whose tool is not there yet leaves the text for the inviter's AI to send. `card` is the link preview's size and how long a made picture is kept. `names_shown` caps the faces a page, email or card draws. Every word is in the pursuit's own name, and `email.sender` is the name the email comes from. Who the people in a pursuit are decides whether a plan is ever named (src/space-membership-kinds.json): a pursuit of a business's members or customers names no plan or price (whoever runs it decides what joining costs, src/community.mjs mayJoin); a team pursuit's page says in `open.fine_team` that joining it comes with a paid plan or a seat its owner pays for, and to a signed-in reader whom that does not cover it shows the invite's own `needs_plan` words (Network.invitePreview) with `page.needs_plan`'s one button.
